final_rationale: V8 crashes with exit code 137 (likely out-of-memory or unhandled exception) when repeatedly calling Reflect.construct with a bound function as newTarget. The bound function has a prototype getter that returns a new object on each access. This leads to the creation of millions of objects within a loop, which V8 fails to handle gracefully, unlike SpiderMonkey, JavaScriptCore, and GraalJS, which complete execution successfully. This indicates a stability issue or a memory management problem in V8.
